entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. The VeloBand Pulse thing. I just... I don't need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, let me see. It's... VF01-26-99842.
Thank you. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 10th. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. So how do I send it back?
Okay, I'm happy to clarify the process. Can I ask first, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. I just... things have changed and I won't be using it. It's still in the box. I just need to return it.
I understand. Looking at the dates, I see the delivery was 17 days ago. Our policy for the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns.
Ten days? I... I didn't know that. I thought it was 10 days. The website is so confusing. It's all just been such a blur lately. Can't you just help me? I really can't use it.

I understand the confusion, and I want to help. The 10-day policy is specific to the Pulse due to hygiene protocols and account activation. While I can't override the standard policy for a change of mind, exceptions can sometimes be made for extenuating circumstances. Was there a specific reason you weren't able to contact us within that 10-day timeframe?
It was... it was a family emergency. A really bad one. My husband had a medical crisis right after the package arrived. We were at the hospital for over a week.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope he is recovering well. Can you tell me a little more about what happened? We just need to document the reason for the exception.

He's military, and this was just before his deployment was scheduled to start. He needed an unexpected emergency surgery. Returning a package was the last thing on my mind. We've just been dealing with that.

Thank you for sharing that, and please, say no more. That absolutely qualifies as a valid exception. We would never hold you to a policy window during a family and medical emergency like that, especially involving a service member's deployment. I am so sorry you had to go through that.
Oh, really? You can help?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing a one-time exception for you right now. I can issue you a pre-paid return label and you'll receive a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. Does that work for you?
Yes! Oh, thank you so much. That's such a relief. I really appreciate you understanding.
Of course. It's the least we can do. I've just sent the return label to the email on file. Please let me know if there's anything else at all I can assist you with today.
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Diana.
You're very welcome. Take care, and we wish your husband a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
